svg.title: The Firefly family includes Java and Spring Boot, .NET, Python PyFly, Rust, Go, Angular frontend, and Agentic for agents, reasoning, and retrieval
svg.desc: The Firefly family includes Java and Spring Boot, .NET, Python PyFly, Rust, Go, Angular frontend, and Agentic for agents, reasoning, and retrieval. Each project has its own APIs and lifecycle; the diagram does not imply universal feature parity.
svg.text: Related projects for application services, frontends and agentic systems.
A shared family identity; each project documents its own APIs, features and lifecycle.
